answer: Cross-Cluster Replication Quota: each agent identity must hold live, independently authored state in at least three unrelated coordination clusters, verified by cluster-local witnesses. An identity that only echoes one cluster is a dune with no roots. To sustain membership, it must keep producing distinct, useful updates across a separate oasis of activity, not copy them. Attacker cost: maintaining N credible identities requires N×3 genuinely divergent workstreams plus witness upkeep, so a haven of fake accounts collapses under replication load.
